verdict.rationale: OpenClaw documents 'nodes': paired companion devices (macOS/iOS/watchOS/Android/headless) that connect to the Gateway and expose command surfaces for camera, screen, device, notifications and system. A built-in computer tool can also see and control a paired node's desktop. Missing for 10: any evidence of media playback on paired devices, and independent hands-on corroboration of the node features (one community report of a Mac click-coordinate bug concerns clicking, not screenshots, camera or notifications).
